title: PulseQueue AI
text:
PulseQueue AI

short_summary:
Early-stage SMB (PulseQueue AI) inbound for hosted API. Wants quick 2-week POC for ticket summarization, structured JSON output, and tool-calling integrations. Cost-sensitive; prefers public cloud hosted with SSO+audit logging. Next: SE-led POC + final pricing.

notes:
SMB inbound from Intercom signup; trial credit applied automatically
Primary product interest = hosted API (self-serve). Wants quick POC, low friction.
Core workload: ticket summarization + automated triage. Also agent-assist snippets and structured field extraction (category, severity, customer_tier).
Latency target: suggestions within 200-300ms for short prompts; batch summarization OK to be slower up to 1s.
Throughput estimate: ~10k incoming tickets/messages per month initially; expect seasonal spikes x2.
Cost sensitivity: SMB — wants default quantized/open model if quality OK; will test cost vs. quality tradeoff.
Model preference: open models acceptable; vendor fallback OK but prefer hosted to avoid infra ops.
Routing/fallback: simple policy desired: primary hosted -> fallback to smaller model if burst; must preserve structured output schema.
Security: needs SSO for admin console, audit logs for admin actions, and KMS for API keys; no air-gapped/on-prem plans now.
Quote from product lead: "We need something that plugs into Zendesk flows and returns structured JSON so our automations don't break."
Requested: sample structured-output schema + few example tool-call flows (open ticket, tag, escalate).
Support stack: Zendesk (tickets), Intercom (messaging), internal CRM (HubSpot).
POC success criteria: 80%+ accuracy for category extraction on 500 sample tickets; median latency <400ms for agent suggestions; cost < $0.05 per ticket before optimizations.
Preferred POC timeline: 2 weeks technical POC, then evaluate for self-serve conversion.

timeline:
2026-02-18 - Inbound demo request via signup form; indicated using Intercom+Zendesk
2026-02-20 - Initial qualification call (Ava) - SMB, wants self-serve hosted, cares about cost
2026-02-24 - Sent hosted API quickstart + sample prompt pack (drive link)
2026-02-28 - Technical sync with Marcus (SE) - discussed tool-calling for triage and structured JSON output for ticket fields
2026-03-05 - Submitted sample Zendesk export (anonymized) for evaluation
2026-03-10 - Follow-up call; product liked, asked about streaming for live agent suggestions and latency targets <300ms
2026-03-11 - Legal requested short security FAQ; awaiting KMS + retention clarifications

next_step:
Set up 2-week POC on hosted API; deliver sample prompt templates + cost estimate

blockers:
data residency questions from legal
need final pricing for 10k msgs/mo
permission to share Zendesk sample export
